title: Find the youngest driver eliminated in Q1 of the 2008 Australian Grand Prix
question: Find the youngest driver eliminated in Q1 of the 2008 Australian Grand Prix, and return their full name, reference name, and the position they held during their fastest lap in any race.

prediction.sql:
WITH q1_eliminated AS (
    SELECT q.XCL_058 AS driver_id
    FROM qualifying AS q
    INNER JOIN races AS r ON q.XCL_057 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Australian Grand Prix'
      AND r.XCL_066 = 2008
      AND q.XCL_063 IS NULL
),
youngest AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034 AS driver_id
    FROM q1_eliminated AS e
    INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON e.driver_id = d.XCL_034
    ORDER BY d.XCL_040 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
fastest_lap_position AS (
    SELECT lt.XCL_046 AS position
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    INNER JOIN results AS res ON lt.XCL_043 = res.XCL_074 AND lt.XCL_044 = res.XCL_075
    WHERE lt.XCL_044 = (SELECT driver_id FROM youngest)
      AND res.XCL_087 = 1
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, d.XCL_035, flp.position
FROM youngest AS y
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON y.driver_id = d.XCL_034
CROSS JOIN fastest_lap_position AS flp
